entries.reviewNotes: Read Japanese context and all twelve complete translation/hint sets. Verified sidewalk sign proposal, forty-centimeter projection, eighty-by-fifty dimensions, property boundary papers, daytime-only placement, consultation before placement, and explicit lack of approval at the current counter. No unsupported installation permission added.

Read Japanese metadata, all eleven turns and hints against all twelve targets. Checked ten oclock examination then one pm shower slot; condition and post-exam instructions precede permission, IV-arm protection, own washed towel drying rail, and nurse check before one. Corrected Indonesian sore to siang for the one pm slot.

Read whole Japanese scenario and all twelve target/hint sets. Verified sidewalk metal hazard used by cyclists, opposite post office three meters beyond crossing, palm-sized plate with upturned edge, ten-minute-old sighting from safe sidewalk edge, no touching and contact for follow-up. Clarified Nepali cyclists passing rather than walking.

Read Japanese metadata and full eleven turns with five hints against all twelve target sets. Verified country on last line, smaller labeled sender at upper left, staff-added airmail mark, upper right free, picture side untouched, postage payment and address-side-only affixing. No invented postage or delivery conditions.

Read Japanese context and all twelve complete targets/hints. Verified only August automatic tuition transfer pause, monthly twenty-fifth six thousand yen, September restart, contract and change-deadline verification before acceptance, both documents and staff consultation. Corrected Hindi single-August-payment ambiguity and Nepali desk wording.

Read Japanese context and all twelve target/hint sets. Verified need only two small potatoes for simmering, adjacent individual-sale box priced by size, transparent bag with outside label, washed stock only in right bagged display, choice of soil-on small quantity and barcode checkout. All quantities and sequence preserved.

Read Japanese metadata and eleven turns with hints against all twelve targets. Verified prior display approval and permit number, center vacant board space, landscape case top fastener, cardboard backing, unclamped edges, next-day personal removal after reception check-in at four before five closure. No extra permission invented.

Read full Japanese context and all twelve complete targets/hints. Verified same-train window-to-aisle change, solo passenger, car six, luggage area three rows away at car end, seat farther back, old-for-new ticket exchange and checking before receipt. Corrected Khmer same train and Burmese/Thai spatial rear-seat wording.

Read metadata and all eleven Japanese turns with hints, plus all twelve translation sets. Verified beginner library read-aloud volunteer observation, next Saturday morning, no book required for observation, later selection with group, practice advice, direct coordinator contact and name/date application. No participation guarantee beyond the offered observation.

Read Japanese discharge context and all twelve full translations/hints. Checked thermometer handover, cushion and call button left on bed, personal charger separated, hospital pajamas and borrowed towel in entrance return bag, own clothes, discharge instructions packed and reception next. Clarified Bengali discharge instructions wording.

Read metadata and all Japanese turns/hints against all twelve target sets. Verified changed branch name and code but same account number, recipient company match, deletion of old registration, registration-only today because invoice amount undecided, final branch/account/name confirmation. No transfer initiated or bank rule invented.

Read full Japanese reserved-bread context and all twelve target/hint sets. Verified Yamamoto collection, two halves without further slicing, one eaten today and other frozen at home, separate bags, freshly warm bread cooled before freezing, both bag mouths slightly open, own carrying bag and upright checkout handling.

Read full Japanese metadata and eleven-turn/hint sequence against all twelve targets. Checked avoiding loud stage-front area, lawn-rear benches not reserved with seated sightline, three oclock start, ten minutes remaining and ten-minute intermission, rear shop, belongings carried when leaving, host announcement and return to rear bench.

Read Japanese ticket-machine context plus all twelve full target/hint sets. Verified round-trip booking with only outbound initially, machine take-ticket message and return left deep in slot, June tenth/twelfth date check, receipt collected, email-only concern retained as passenger belief, empty slot and separate ticket pockets.

Read Japanese relocation context and all twelve complete target/hint sets. Verified large map replaces unreadable small map, collection point before river without bridge crossing, Monday collection change, Sunday-night question left dependent on district permitted-time notice, marked corner diagram taken home. Corrected Burmese when-versus-where start question.

Read all Japanese context/turns/hints and all twelve full targets. Verified hospital white towel edge mark versus two personal blue towels, damp mixed bag, named towel found at basin, white returned to collection bag, drawer/basin check and complete discharge belongings. Corrected ownership in Indonesian/Khmer and Bengali discharge wording.

Read full Japanese road-mirror context plus twelve complete target/hint sets. Verified red pole at narrow-to-main intersection, after strong wind sky replaces right-approaching traffic, no accident seen, morning driving danger, no attempt to adjust mirror, photo and manager referral. Corrected unsupported Chinese phone contact and Nepali strong-wind omission.

Read all Japanese original-contract context and twelve complete target/hint sets. Checked signed originals requested by counterpart, no return items, unsealed envelope, no own copy yet, two sheets copied while originals alone mailed, copier at shop entrance and thirty remaining minutes. Corrected copier landmark and remaining-time/return-to-mail ambiguities.

Read Japanese annual-insurance budget context plus all twelve full target/hint sets. Checked sixty thousand yen due next June, twelve monthly five-thousand preparations, actual expense distinct from earmarked money, existing ten thousand separately reserved, other spending review, June expense and reserve drawdown recorded without double-counting.

Read Japanese frozen-shopping context and all twelve complete targets/hints. Verified vegetables and rice first, frozen udon last at rear section, insulated bag folded until checkout, two five-serving packs, twenty-minute bus home with own ice packs, grouped frozen items packed immediately after payment. No cold-chain duration guarantee added.

Read metadata and full Japanese cheque deposit context against twelve complete target/hint sets. Checked work-payment cheque fifty thousand yen, own account/passbook, first receipt, collection method and credit delay explained by staff, availability checked before payment promise, possible fees and net amount, handover receipt and distinct cheque-receipt versus credit dates.

Read Japanese hand-roll nori context and all twelve target/hint sets. Verified seasoned small pieces versus roasted whole sheets, halving ten into twenty for four people, five-sheet alternative declined, ten-sheet one-packet choice, back storage and closure instructions checked. Counts, flavor/type distinction and leftovers handling preserved.

Read Japanese cleanup activity context plus all twelve complete target/hint sets. Verified rake versus broom on lawn, gentle tips avoid pulling soil, leaves toward path, branches separately in basket and leaves in open bag, designated staff collection point, rake return stand and next participant readiness. All task order and separation retained.

Read Japanese receipt issuance context and all twelve targets/hints. Verified ticket already held, missed receipt button, far-left machine cash purchase five minutes ago, fare and route check at counter, full company addressee without abbreviation, receipt stored separately and only ticket used at gate. Preserved exact Japanese company spelling in Traditional Chinese.

Read full Japanese old-newsletter context and all twelve complete target/hint sets. Checked last-summer festival, July/August unknown month, large drum photo clue, two bound volumes for on-site reading only, borrowed pencil, August article page and date noted, both volumes and pencil returned to desk. All clues and return count preserved.

Read complete Japanese post-blood-draw context and all twelve translation/hint sets. Verified tight sleeve, straight-arm pressure, patient discloses blood-thinning medication and morning dose in record, continued cotton blood concern, nurse checks hemostasis before slow sleeve lowering without constriction, immediate report if recurrent bleeding. No invented wait duration or drug instruction.

Read Japanese secondhand-bicycle context and all twelve complete targets/hints. Verified hard-to-read anti-theft sticker, nearby shop purchase with receipt but prior owner unexplained, shop referral for owner change and documents, stamped frame number distinct from sticker with model-dependent location, bicycle/receipt start consultation without claiming all required documents satisfied.

Read full Japanese envelope-glue context and all twelve complete targets/hints. Checked dry adhesive leaves flap open, two photos not creased, contents pushed clear of glue, writing table borrowed for pressing, corners sealed, weighing then fictional 110-yen postage, stamp not yet affixed, glue returned and envelope handed in. No unsupported postage rule added.

changes.before: Pemeriksaannya pukul sepuluh. Apakah menginginkan slot sore?
changes.after: Pemeriksaannya pukul sepuluh. Apakah menginginkan slot siang?
changes.reason: The requested afternoon slot is one pm, which is siang rather than late-afternoon sore in Indonesian.

changes.before: हो। फुटपाथमा धारिलो धातुको टुक्रा थियो। साइकल चढ्ने पनि त्यहाँ हिँड्छन्।
changes.after: हो। फुटपाथमा धारिलो धातुको टुक्रा थियो। साइकल यात्रीहरू पनि त्यहाँबाट जान्छन्।
changes.reason: Preserve cyclists also passing the location without describing them as walking there.

changes.before: जिम्मेवारको मेचमा सल्लाह लिन मिल्छ। पासबुक र स्वचालित स्थानान्तरणको प्रति छ?
changes.after: जिम्मेवार कर्मचारीको डेस्कमा परामर्श लिन मिल्छ। पासबुक र स्वचालित स्थानान्तरणको प्रति छ?
changes.reason: 担当席 means the responsible staff desk, not a chair as Nepali मेच denotes.

changes.before: कागजात लिएर जिम्मेवारको मेचमा जानुहोस्। धन्यवाद।
changes.after: कागजात लिएर जिम्मेवार कर्मचारीको डेस्कमा जानुहोस्। परामर्शका लागि धन्यवाद।
changes.reason: Preserve the instruction to go to the staff desk, not the staff chair, and consultation thanks.

changes.before: लगातार बंद नहीं बल्कि केवल एक अगस्त रोकना स्पष्ट करें। जापानी में कहें।
changes.after: लगातार रोकने के बजाय केवल अगस्त का एक भुगतान रोकना स्पष्ट करें। जापानी में कहें।
changes.reason: एक अगस्त can mean August first; the source specifies one August payment pause rather than a calendar day.

changes.before: တစ်ယောက်တည်းပါ။ အခုခုံထက်နောက်ကျသွားပေမယ့် ပစ္စည်းထားရာနီးလား။
changes.after: တစ်ယောက်တည်းပါ။ အခုခုံထက် နောက်ဘက်ပိုကျတဲ့ခုံဖြစ်ပေမယ့် ပစ္စည်းထားရာနီးလား။
changes.reason: 後ろ is spatial farther back in the carriage, not a temporal delay suggested by နောက်ကျ.

changes.before: ខ្សែដដែលមែនទេ? ខ្ញុំនឹងពិនិត្យកៅអីបច្ចុប្បន្ន។
changes.after: រថភ្លើងដដែលមែនទេ? ខ្ញុំនឹងពិនិត្យកៅអីបច្ចុប្បន្ន។
changes.reason: The passenger keeps the same train service, not merely the same line or route.

changes.before: คนเดียวครับ หลังจากที่เดิม แต่ที่วางกระเป๋าใกล้ไหมครับ
changes.after: คนเดียวครับ ที่นั่งใหม่อยู่ค่อนไปทางด้านหลังมากกว่าที่นั่งเดิม แต่ใกล้ที่วางกระเป๋าไหมครับ
changes.reason: Clarify a seat farther back in the car, avoiding temporal after-the-old-place wording.

changes.before: তোয়ালেও দিন। ছাড়ের নির্দেশ কাছে আছে, তাই তো?
changes.after: তোয়ালেও দিন। হাসপাতাল থেকে ছাড়পত্রের নির্দেশনা আপনার কাছে আছে, তাই তো?
changes.reason: Use explicit hospital discharge instructions, avoiding ছাড়ের which can be read as discount-related instructions.

changes.before: တံတားမဖြတ်ရဘူးနော်။ ဘယ်ကစသုံးမယ့်နေရာပြောင်းလဲ။
changes.after: တံတားမဖြတ်ရဘူးနော်။ အသုံးပြုရမယ့်နေရာက ဘယ်အချိန်ကစပြီး ပြောင်းမှာလဲ။
changes.reason: いつから asks when the collection location changes, not from where; retain temporal start-date question.

changes.before: Itu saya. Saya terima itu dan masukkan yang putih ke kantong pengumpulan.
changes.after: Itu milik saya. Saya ambil handuk itu dan memasukkan yang putih ke kantong pengumpulan.
changes.reason: それは私のです identifies towel ownership, not the speaker themselves.

changes.before: នោះខ្ញុំ។ ខ្ញុំទទួលនោះហើយដាក់សក្នុងថង់ប្រមូល។
changes.after: នោះជារបស់ខ្ញុំ។ ខ្ញុំនឹងទទួលកន្សែងនោះ ហើយដាក់កន្សែងសក្នុងថង់ប្រមូល។
changes.reason: Identify the tagged towel as mine rather than saying that is me; preserve hospital towel return.

changes.before: ছাড়ের জিনিস গোছানো হয়েছে?
changes.after: হাসপাতাল থেকে ছাড়া পাওয়ার জন্য আপনার জিনিসপত্র গোছানো হয়েছে?
changes.reason: Explicit hospital discharge packing avoids ambiguous discount goods wording.

changes.before: ছাড়ের জিনিসে হাসপাতাল তোয়ালে মিশেছে বলুন। জাপানিতে বলুন।
changes.after: হাসপাতাল থেকে বাড়ি ফেরার জিনিসপত্রে হাসপাতালের তোয়ালে মিশে গেছে বলে জানান। জাপানিতে বলুন।
changes.reason: The hint concerns discharge belongings, not discount goods; retain hospital towel mixed in.

changes.before: 看过照片，感谢来电告知。
changes.after: 看过照片，感谢您联系告知。
changes.reason: The Japanese thanks contact without specifying a telephone call, while map/photo are shown in conversation.

changes.before: हिजोको हावापछि। पहिले दायाँबाट गाडी देखिन्थ्यो, अहिले आकाश।
changes.after: हिजोको तेज हावापछि। पहिले दायाँबाट आउने गाडी देखिन्थ्यो, अहिले आकाश देखिन्छ।
changes.reason: Retain strong wind and right-approaching vehicles rather than dropping the wind strength.

changes.before: Máy ở cửa hàng. Quầy này còn mở ba mươi phút.
changes.after: Có máy photocopy ở lối vào cửa hàng. Quầy này còn mở thêm ba mươi phút.
changes.reason: Retain the exact copier landmark at the shop entrance, not only somewhere in the shop.

changes.before: Kalau begitu sekarang saya ke sana. Salinan masuk berkas saya lalu saya minta pengiriman aslinya kembali.
changes.after: Kalau begitu saya ke sana sekarang. Salinannya saya simpan dalam berkas saya, lalu saya kembali ke loket untuk meminta agar dokumen asli dikirim.
changes.reason: The original is to be sent after returning to the counter, not sent back as pengiriman kembali could imply.

changes.before: ဆိုင်ဝင်ပေါက်မှာစက်ရှိပါတယ်။ ကောင်တာနောက်မိနစ်သုံးဆယ်ဖွင့်ပါတယ်။
changes.after: ဆိုင်ဝင်ပေါက်မှာ မိတ္တူစက်ရှိပါတယ်။ ဒီကောင်တာက နောက်ထပ် မိနစ်သုံးဆယ် ဆက်ဖွင့်ထားပါမယ်။
changes.reason: Clarify the counter remains open for thirty more minutes rather than opens after thirty minutes.

changes.before: งั้นไปตอนนี้ครับ เก็บสำเนาแฟ้มตัวเองแล้วขอส่งต้นใหม่ครับ
changes.after: งั้นผมจะไปตอนนี้ครับ เก็บสำเนาไว้ในแฟ้มของตัวเองแล้วจะกลับมาขอส่งต้นฉบับอีกครั้งครับ
changes.reason: The speaker returns to request mailing the same original after keeping copies; avoid a new-original reading.

changes.before: 是“青空工業株式會社”。請不要縮寫，按這個完整名稱填寫。
changes.after: 是“青空工業株式会社”。請不要縮寫，按這個完整名稱填寫。
changes.reason: The dialogue explicitly requires the exact full Japanese company name; do not convert the legal-name character 会 to 會.

scope: AI Japanese context and all12 sentence/task sets; native/source/device approval separate.
